groups.root_cause: The migration decides which worktrees are legacy using a hard-coded timestamp cutoff. That cutoff does not match when each installation actually upgraded, and the test fixtures hide the gap.
The migration only treats a run as eligible if baseline-check evidence exists, but a run interrupted during prepare may never have emitted that evidence.
Worktree registration in the engine only accepts checkouts that come from the bare cache, so it rejects legacy checkouts that belong to the original local source repository.
On resume, the new headSha Git probe runs before the needsHuman check, so a Git error replaces the human-review status of runs that are already waiting for review.
